prose: Emily Ridout returns for her third InnerVerse appearance, this time to talk about psychic vampires, energetic drainers, and parasitic self images. We explore how one can repair and utilize their own cosmic energy connection to burn so brightly that no creatures of darkness can abide in the Presence.
ext: We look at humanity's vampiric relationship with the Earth, collective parasitic behavior (like government), and the possibility of purely astral vampire entities.
